note: Element library catalog. 'elementor' says whether Elementor has it (free/pro) or not at all; 'elementor_gap' = what Elementor lacks or limits (from general knowledge + sources in README; verify), 'vsn_extras' = settings VSN adds on top of the universal settings. Every element also gets every group in universal-settings.json.

elements.name: Container / Group
elements.elementor_gap: flex only per container, no CSS grid areas per breakpoint
elements.vsn_extras: flex + grid modes, grid template per breakpoint, sticky, overflow, min-height in vh/svh, full-bleed

elements.name: Grid
elements.elementor_gap: basic grid, no masonry or bento spans
elements.vsn_extras: bento spans per item, masonry, auto-fit/auto-fill, dense packing, per-breakpoint columns
